title: ION Identifiable Location Schema Pack v1

IdentifiableLocation.title: IdentifiableLocation
IdentifiableLocation.description: Beckn Location wire shape with a stable local identifier. The identifier is used by sibling or related objects that cannot safely address an element by array position or geometry equality.
IdentifiableLocation.x-beckn-attaches-to: (reusable shape — embedded by ION attribute packs that require stable location references)

id.description: Identifier unique within the enclosing object or transaction scope.

geo.description: Authoritative geometry, using the Beckn Location property definition.

address.description: Optional postal address, using the Beckn Location property definition.
